verdict: Organic reach dropped sharply this week; no paid activity is running.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all traffic to your business came from organic sources — no paid advertising was active on any channel. Within that window, the most recent 7 days saw a significant pullback: Google Search clicks fell 81% compared to the prior 7 days, and Google Business Profile engagement dropped 68%, with both landing at zero for the last three days. Website sessions held relatively steady (-7%), suggesting some visitors are still arriving through direct or referral paths, but none are completing an intake action — zero conversions were recorded against 175 sessions this period. We are addressing the organic visibility drop and the gap in your on-site intake flow now, so next period should show both stabilized search presence and a clearer path for arriving visitors to connect with you.

Google Business Profile actions (calls, direction requests, site clicks) in the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: Search visibility and Business Profile engagement have stalled to near-zero over the last several days, cutting off the primary source of inbound interest.
watch_item.fix: We are actively investigating the organic visibility drop and tightening the on-site intake path so that visitors who do arrive have a clear next step to reach you.
